prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 36 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1091; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with reported head impact and symptoms consistent with concussion, including headache, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the diagnosis. There is no known prior injury to the head or neck region. Over the course of care, the patient has attended 36 visits. Treatment expanded over several months, with additional services added beyond what is typically required for a concussion of this severity, and the treatment plan was revised several times as new referrals were made. A billing review found no repeated or duplicate charges for the services rendered. Current status shows partial improvement in cognitive and symptom scores, and the patient is being reassessed to determine whether further services remain medically necessary.
